quick: 100 to 200 mg per dose in combinations, two to three times daily; 500 mg twice daily when used alone
summary: Rutoside (rutin) is a flavonoid glycoside claimed to reduce capillary permeability. In India it is mostly combined with trypsin and bromelain for post-operative swelling, and with other flavonoids for venous insufficiency. Supporting evidence is limited.
indications: Adjunct for oedema after trauma or surgery (with proteolytic enzymes)
Chronic venous insufficiency and haemorrhoids (limited evidence)

dosage.d: 100 to 200 mg per dose in combinations, two to three times daily; 500 mg twice daily when used alone

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Antioxidant flavonoid thought to stabilise capillary walls and reduce permeability; human data are limited.
preg: Safety not established; use only if clearly needed
lact: Safety not established; weigh benefit against unknown risk
counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
